images.prompt:
EDIT / OUTPAINT Image 1. Deliver exactly ONE 1536x1024 PNG. Image 1 is the edit canvas, Image 2 is supporting painted style and sunset palette only; do not copy its layout or objects. Preserve Image 1's TOP 256 rows and LEFT 256 columns including the top-left corner EXACTLY, in place and unchanged. Paint only the placeholder rectangle x=256..1535, y=256..1023, seamlessly continuing every existing mist shape at its top and left boundaries. No straight joins at x=256 or y=256. This is the lower-right panel of a continuous 2x2 parallax MIST layer with 256-pixel overlaps. Soft drifting banks of pale warm mist and low cloud, peach, rose and lavender lit by sunset, painted as LIGHT on flat PURE BLACK #000000 background: black means transparent in game, brighter means denser mist. Continue the upper boundary banks organically into fine wispy extensions and substantial pure black openings in the upper half; build thick dense rolling mist banks toward the bottom, following existing bottom-left clouds across the new bottom area. Only mist, no land, cliff rim, trees, architecture, sky colour, sun, horizon, characters, creatures, text, UI, border, or vignette. Hand-drawn painted 2D animation style with clean painted planes, restrained surface texture and graphic cloud shapes, delicate tapered edges lighter and thinner with distance, cool lavender shadow planes and peach/rose illuminated planes matching the existing strips. No conspicuous grain. The existing painted strips are immutable neighbour pixels: no recoloring, moving, resizing, cropping, or repainting those strips. Retain the exact original canvas framing and size. Fill and continue the black placeholder region only, leaving pure black between mist shapes.
TARGETED SEAM CORRECTION: The previous attempt left a vertical colour/shape discontinuity at x=256 in the lower cloud bank and a straight horizontal boundary at y=256. Avoid these joins by matching the EXACT local colour, brightness, brush-mark scale and cloud contours of the existing boundary pixels within the NEW editable region. Continue shapes crossing x=255 into x=256 and beyond without a change in hue or brightness; likewise carry shapes crossing y=255 downward into y=256 and beyond. Build the new painting outward from these boundaries, with a broad organic transition inside the placeholder, never a rectangular patch. Especially continue the peach/lavender cloud in the bottom-left at the same brightness immediately across x=256 before gradually developing the rest of the thick bottom bank. Preserve every pixel in the original top and left strips. Original Image 1 remains the canvas to edit; Image 2 remains style only.
